grammar.pattern: 完成动作 + 了 + 就 + 后续动作
grammar.explanation: 看了通知就问她 says the asking follows reading the notice. The second event is not necessarily guaranteed whenever the first occurs; read the stated context and tense. 买了就用 is distinct from 一买就用 habitual or immediate framing.

examples.py: wǒ kàn le tōng zhī jiù wèn tā .
examples.en: After reading the notice I asked her.

examples.py: dào le shì chǎng jiù hé duì jià gé .
examples.en: After reaching the market, check prices.

examples.py: tā wèn le tiáo jiàn jiù jì xià lái .
examples.en: After asking the conditions, she notes them.

commonMistakes.wrong: 看了通知就问她，说明没看通知。
commonMistakes.right: 这句话先说看通知，再说问她。
commonMistakes.why: The first event precedes the second in this report.

grammar.pattern: 数量 + 左右 / 大约 + 数量；相邻数
grammar.explanation: 十个人左右 and 大约十个人 are approximate, not exactly ten. 三四个人 is normally three or four people; do not generalize adjacent numerals to a mathematically exact range in every context. Avoid redundant 大约…左右 in careful precision tasks.

examples.py: shí gè rén zuǒ yòu cān jiā .
sān sì gè rén hái méi dào .
examples.en: Three or four people have not arrived.

commonMistakes.wrong: 十个人左右就是正好十个。
commonMistakes.right: 十个人左右是大概，不是精确数。
commonMistakes.why: Approximation does not establish exact equality.

dialogue.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 昨天的车费你算好了吗？
lines.py: zuó tiān de chē fèi nǐ suàn hǎo le ma ?
lines.en: Have you worked out yesterday's fares?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 算了。四个人一共一百二十，每人三十。
lines.py: suàn le . sì gè rén yī gòng yī bǎi èr shí , měi rén sān shí .
lines.en: Yes. A hundred and twenty for four people, so thirty each.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那饭钱呢？我记得大约两百。
lines.py: nà fàn qián ne ? wǒ jì de dà yuē liǎng bǎi .
lines.en: What about dinner? I remember it being about two hundred.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 实际是一百八十。你们把钱转给我，我收到了就发收据。
lines.py: shí jì shì yī bǎi bā shí . nǐ men bǎ qián zhuǎn gěi wǒ , wǒ shōu dào le jiù fā shōu jù .
lines.en: It was actually a hundred and eighty. Transfer me the money and I'll send the receipt when I get it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 所以每人一共七十五？
lines.py: suǒ yǐ měi rén yī gòng qī shí wǔ ?
lines.en: So seventy-five each in total?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。比上次增加了十块，主要是车费涨了。
lines.py: duì . bǐ shàng cì zēng jiā le shí kuài , zhǔ yào shì chē fèi zhǎng le .
lines.en: Right. Ten more than last time, mainly because fares went up.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不过那个市场挺值得去的，小吃很有特色。
lines.py: bù guò nà gè shì chǎng tǐng zhí de qù de , xiǎo chī hěn yǒu tè sè .
lines.en: Still, that market was worth visiting. The snacks were distinctive.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我也觉得值。下次早一点去，坐公交车能省一点。
lines.py: wǒ yě jué de zhí . xià cì zǎo yī diǎn qù , zuò gōng jiāo chē néng shěng yī diǎn .
lines.en: I think it was worth it too. Next time let's go earlier; taking the bus would save a bit.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，我转完钱就把照片发群里。
lines.py: xíng , wǒ zhuǎn wán qián jiù bǎ zhào piān fā qún lǐ .
lines.en: Okay. I'll send the photos to the group after transferring the money.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先把我闭着眼的那张删了，求你了。
lines.py: xiān bǎ wǒ bì zhuó yǎn de nà zhāng shān le , qiú nǐ le .
lines.en: Please delete the one where my eyes are shut first. I'm begging you.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Costs without invented precision
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 周六，我们四个人去了城南的市场。出发前，大家预计每人花七十块左右，车费和饭钱都算在里面。
lines.py: zhōu liù , wǒ men sì gè rén qù le chéng nán de shì chǎng . chū fā qián , dà jiā yù jì měi rén huā qī shí kuài zuǒ yòu , chē fèi hé fàn qián dōu suàn zài lǐ miàn .
lines.en: On Saturday four of us went to the market in the south of town. Before leaving we estimated around seventy yuan each, including transport and dinner.

lines.zh: 那天起床晚了，到了车站才发现公交车刚走。我们等了一会儿，就决定一起打车。
lines.py: nà tiān qǐ chuáng wǎn le , dào le chē zhàn cái fā xiàn gōng jiāo chē gāng zǒu . wǒ men děng le yī huì er , jiù jué dìng yì qǐ dǎ chē .
lines.en: We got up late and discovered at the station that the bus had just left. After waiting a while, we decided to share a taxi.

lines.zh: 市场比照片上热闹。当地的小吃很有特色，同一种商品在不同店里的价格也不一样。
lines.py: shì chǎng bǐ zhào piān shàng rè nào . dāng dì de xiǎo chī hěn yǒu tè sè , tóng yī zhǒng shāng pǐn zài bù tóng diàn lǐ de jià gé yě bù yī yàng .
lines.en: The market was livelier than in the photographs. The local snacks were distinctive, and the same goods had different prices in different shops.

lines.zh: 朋友买完东西就去问路，我们在旁边等她。老板介绍了一家饭馆，四个人吃饭一共花了一百八十。
lines.py: péng you mǎi wán dōng xi jiù qù wèn lù , wǒ men zài páng biān děng tā . lǎo bǎn jiè shào le yī jiā fàn guǎn , sì gè rén chī fàn yī gòng huā le yī bǎi bā shí .
lines.en: Once my friend had finished shopping she asked for directions while we waited nearby. A shopkeeper recommended a restaurant, where dinner for four cost a hundred and eighty.

lines.zh: 回家以后，我们把每一笔钱加起来。车费一百二十，饭钱一百八十，购物的钱各自付。最后每人七十五，比预计多了五块。
lines.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ men bǎ měi yī bǐ qián jiā qǐ lái . chē fèi yī bǎi èr shí , fàn qián yī bǎi bā shí , gòu wù de qián gè zì fù . zuì hòu měi rén qī shí wǔ , bǐ yù jì duō le wǔ kuài .
lines.en: Back home we added up the shared expenses: a hundred and twenty for fares and a hundred and eighty for dinner, with shopping paid separately. Each person owed seventy-five, five more than estimated.

lines.zh: 虽然多花了一点，我仍然觉得这次出门值得。下次早点出发，不仅能少等一会儿，也能坐公交车省钱。
lines.py: suī rán duō huā le yī diǎn , wǒ réng rán jué de zhè cì chū mén zhí de . xià cì zǎo diǎn chū fā , bù jǐn néng shǎo děng yī huì er , yě néng zuò gōng jiāo chē shěng qián .
lines.en: Although we spent a little more, I still thought the trip was worthwhile. Leaving earlier next time would mean less waiting and saving money by taking the bus.

choices: A trip and the final division of shared costs
A plan to invest in a market
questions.answer: A trip and the final division of shared costs

choices: Each person paid for their own purchases
It was included in the shared 75 yuan
questions.answer: Each person paid for their own purchases

lines.py: zhè gè shì chǎng zhōu yī bù kāi fàng .
lines.en: This market is closed on Mondays.

lines.zh: 她在大学学经济。
lines.py: tā zài dà xué xué jīng jì .
lines.en: She studies economics at university.

lines.zh: 春天到了，气温逐渐上升。
lines.py: chūn tiān dào le , qì wēn zhú jiàn shàng shēng .
lines.en: As spring arrives, the temperature gradually rises.

lines.zh: 我们又增加了两个座位。
lines.py: wǒ men yòu zēng jiā le liǎng gè zuò wèi .
lines.en: We added two more seats.

lines.zh: 小店的收入每年都在增长。
lines.py: xiǎo diàn de shōu rù měi nián dōu zài zēng zhǎng .
lines.en: The small shop's income increases every year.

lines.zh: 房间的温度升了两度。
lines.py: fáng jiān de wēn dù shēng le liǎng dù .
lines.en: The room temperature went up two degrees.

lines.zh: 这么好的书，值这个价。
lines.py: zhè me hǎo de shū , zhí zhè gè jià .
lines.en: A book this good is worth the price.

lines.zh: 为了这场演出跑这么远，值得吗？
lines.py: wèi le zhè chǎng yǎn chū pǎo zhè me yuǎn , zhí de ma ?
lines.en: Is travelling this far for the performance worthwhile?

lines.zh: 她的声音在合唱里特别突出。
lines.py: tā de shēng yīn zài hé chàng lǐ tè bié tū chū .
lines.en: Her voice really stands out in the choir.

lines.zh: 这里的特色是手工做的面条。
lines.py: zhè lǐ de tè sè shì shǒu gōng zuò de miàn tiáo .
lines.en: The speciality here is handmade noodles.

lines.zh: 手机支付已经很普及了。
lines.py: shǒu jī zhī fù yǐ jīng hěn pǔ jí le .
lines.en: Mobile payment is now widespread.

lines.zh: 这座城市的公共交通很发达。
lines.py: zhè zuò chéng shì de gōng gòng jiāo tōng hěn fā dá .
lines.en: This city's public transport is well developed.

lines.zh: 这种原料来自石油。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng yuán liào lái zì shí yóu .
lines.en: This raw material comes from petroleum.

lines.zh: 这个环可以挂钥匙。
lines.py: zhè gè huán kě yǐ guà yào shi .
lines.en: This ring can hold keys.

lines.zh: 学校举办了一次环保活动。
lines.py: xué xiào jǔ bàn le yī cì huán bǎo huó dòng .
lines.en: The school held an environmental protection event.

lines.zh: 窗外的环境很安静。
lines.py: chuāng wài de huán jìng hěn ān jìng .
lines.en: The surroundings outside the window are very quiet.

lines.zh: 任他怎么叫，小猫都不肯出来。
lines.py: rèn tā zěn me jiào , xiǎo māo dōu bù kěn chū lái .
lines.en: However much he calls, the kitten refuses to come out.

lines.zh: 他不想说某个人的名字，只告诉我那是以前的同学。
lines.py: tā bù xiǎng shuō mǒu gè rén de míng zi , zhǐ gào sù wǒ nà shì yǐ qián de tóng xué .
lines.en: He didn’t want to name a certain person, only saying it was a former classmate.

lines.zh: 这条街以前是商业街，现在大部分店都搬走了。
lines.py: zhè tiáo jiē yǐ qián shì shāng yè jiē , xiàn zài dà bù fèn diàn dōu bān zǒu le .
lines.en: This used to be a shopping street; most shops have moved away now.

lines.zh: 这篇文章讲的是当地的经济。
lines.py: zhè piān wén zhāng jiǎng de shì dāng dì de jīng jì .
lines.en: This article is about the local economy.

lines.zh: 河里的水位上升了，大家别靠近岸边。
lines.py: hé lǐ de shuǐ wèi shàng shēng le , dà jiā bié kào jìn àn biān .
lines.en: The river level has risen; keep away from the bank.

lines.zh: 这个月，来图书馆的人数增长了不少。
lines.py: zhè gè yuè , lái tú shū guǎn de rén shù zēng zhǎng le bù shǎo .
lines.en: The number of library visitors has grown considerably this month.

lines.zh: 海报上最突出的字是活动日期。
lines.py: hǎi bào shàng zuì tū chū de zì shì huó dòng rì qī .
lines.en: The most prominent words on the poster are the event date.

lines.zh: 手机已经很普及，买票也越来越方便。
lines.py: shǒu jī yǐ jīng hěn pǔ jí , mǎi piào yě yuè lái yuè fāng biàn .
lines.en: Mobile phones are widespread now, and buying tickets is becoming easier.

lines.zh: 这里公共交通很发达，不开车也能到很多地方。
lines.py: zhè lǐ gōng gòng jiāo tōng hěn fā dá , bù kāi chē yě néng dào hěn duō dì fāng .
lines.en: Public transport is well developed here; you can get to many places without a car.

lines.zh: 这家公司以前主要做石油生意。
lines.py: zhè jiā gōng sī yǐ qián zhǔ yào zuò shí yóu shēng yì .
lines.en: This company used to deal mainly in oil.

lines.zh: 我买了一个环保袋，以后不用每次都拿新袋子。
lines.py: wǒ mǎi le yī gè huán bǎo dài , yǐ hòu bù yòng měi cì dōu ná xīn dài zi .
lines.en: I bought a reusable bag so I won’t need a new bag every time.

lines.zh: 这家店环境安静，很适合看书。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn huán jìng ān jìng , hěn shì hé kàn shū .
lines.en: This shop has a quiet atmosphere and is a good place to read.

lines.zh: 太阳从山后升起来了。
lines.py: tài yáng cóng shān hòu shēng qǐ lái le .
lines.en: The sun rose from behind the mountains.

lines.zh: 她用线把两个环连在一起。
lines.py: tā yòng xiàn bǎ liǎng gè huán lián zài yì qǐ .
lines.en: She joined two rings together with string.

audio.zh: 算了。四个人一共一百二十，每人三十。
audio.py: suàn le . sì gè rén yī gòng yī bǎi èr shí , měi rén sān shí .
audio.en: Yes. A hundred and twenty for four people, so thirty each.

tasks.why: 120 yuan is the total fare; divided by four it is 30 each.

audio.zh: 周六，我们四个人去了城南的市场。出发前，大家预计每人花七十块左右，车费和饭钱都算在里面。
audio.py: zhōu liù , wǒ men sì gè rén qù le chéng nán de shì chǎng . chū fā qián , dà jiā yù jì měi rén huā qī shí kuài zuǒ yòu , chē fèi hé fàn qián dōu suàn zài lǐ miàn .
audio.en: On Saturday four of us went to the market in the south of town. Before leaving we estimated around seventy yuan each, including transport and dinner.

tasks.statement: Four people planned to visit a market on Saturday.

prompt.py: měi rén yī gòng qī shí wǔ , duì ma ?

choices: 对，车费三十，饭钱四十五。
tasks.answer: 对，车费三十，饭钱四十五。

prompt.py: wèi shén me xià cì zǎo diǎn chū fā ?

choices: 可以坐公交车，省一点钱。
tasks.answer: 可以坐公交车，省一点钱。
tasks.why: Earlier departure permits the cheaper bus option.

line.zh: 【任】他说什么，我都想自己试试。
line.py: rèn tā shuō shén me , wǒ dōu xiǎng zì jǐ shì shì .
line.en: Whatever he says, I want to try it myself.

line.zh: 这位老师被大家称【为】老朋友。
line.py: zhè wèi lǎo shī bèi dà jiā chēng wéi lǎo péng yǒu .
line.en: Everyone calls this teacher an old friend.

AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三73, 三74. Native check: 任 conjunction, 为 wéi in 作为, 了…就 narrative scope, approximate adjacent numerals, count versus percentage. No investment, purchasing or eligibility advice. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三55 / 三77 / 三64 / 三65: 行李被同学移到门后了。, 我是来领行李的。, 首先确认时间，然后报名。, 她核对时间，并且问了地点。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Trip budget: arithmetic 120+180=300, four shares of 75; forecast 70 versus actual 75, each person’s shopping excluded. Completed-action 就 in new contexts; no commercial advice in dialogue. Native check: 绕湖一环 and comic 五倍 delivery. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
